phrases.latin: «Quid tū es tam trīstis, pāvō?» inquit. «Nōlī trīstis esse! Etiam sine caudā pulcher es!»
phrases.english: “Why are you so sad, peacock?” he said. “Don’t be sad! You’re handsome even without a tail!”
